about: Land surface (skin) temperature for the Discover Jordan 10 km boxes (grid jordan-10km-v1 of data/screening_jordan.json) from NASA MODIS MOD21A2 (Terra) + MYD21A2 (Aqua) Collection 6.1, 8-day, 1 km, composites starting 2003-2020: the same derived values as the sites in data/lst.json, computed for every 1 km MODIS pixel whose centre lies in the box and averaged over the box, plus the single pixel at the box centre. Clear-sky satellite measurements of the ground surface; not air temperature. Built by scripts/fetch_lst.py from COG range reads (tiles h20v05, h21v05, h21v06); see data/raw/lst/README.txt.

period.rule: every 8-day composite whose start date is in 2003-2020, Terra and Aqua

qcRule: A value is used when LST is not the fill value 0 and its QC byte (MOD21 C6.1 user guide, Table 13, bit 0 = least significant) has mandatory QA bits 1-0 = 00 (produced, good quality) or 01 (produced, nominal/other quality) AND LST accuracy bits 7-6 = 01 (1.5-2 K), 10 (1-1.5 K) or 11 (<1 K), i.e. the estimated LST error is at most 2 K; bits 7-6 = 00 (>2 K, poor) and mandatory 10 (cloud) / 11 (other) are rejected. Bits 3-2 (L1B data quality) and 5-4 (emissivity accuracy) are not used. This mirrors the MOD11 'standard' rule (good or other quality with LST error <= 2 K); note the MOD21 bits 7-6 run the other way from MOD11's.
pixelRule: Each 1 km pixel gets the site statistics of data/lst.json (derivedRules there): mean of the four overpass means, Aqua day mean minus Aqua night mean, and the coldest valid Aqua night composite. A series (Terra/Aqua x day/night) counts for a pixel only when at least 50 % of that satellite's composites pass QC there; a statistic is valid when all the series it needs count.
boxRule: Box value = mean of the valid pixel values over all 1 km MODIS sinusoidal pixels whose centre falls inside the box (row/col by the grid's pointToBox rule), kept only when at least 50 % of the box's pixels have a valid value for that statistic (else null). validShare = share of the box's pixels valid for all three statistics. nPix = pixels in the box. coldSurface_C of a box is the mean of each pixel's own coldest composite (dates differ between pixels). centre = the same three values at the single 1 km pixel that holds the box centre (lat/lon of the box).

biases.meanSurface_C: about +2 to +3 K warmer than a true 24 h mean (four fixed overpass times)
biases.swingSurface_C: captures about 88 % of the true daily range
biases.coldSurface_C: an 8-day mean of ~01:30 values; single nights get several K colder

flagRules.water: 50 % or more of the box's 1 km pixels are mostly water (at least 3 of their 4 500 m sub-pixels have a permanent-water code in the MODIS land/water flag, MOD09A1 v061 state bits 3-5; codes as in data/lst.json derivedRules.flags.water); the values mix water and land
flagRules.partWater: 20 to 50 % of the box's pixels are mostly water
flagRules.centreWater: the centre pixel is mostly water
